description: Find ranked specialty espresso cafes within a radius of given coordinates. Returns cafes from the curated database sorted by espresso-quality score, with distance and score reasoning for each.

limit.description: Maximum number of cafes to return. Default 10.

min_score.description: Filter out cafes below this espresso quality score (0-100). Default 50.

name: find_espresso_near
title: Find Espresso Near a Location
